subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Some of the Kenyans (i) maintains two households are to at a time (b) Leading two families (ii) leading a modern life (c) Many of them have (iii) pose a dilemma for them come to city for (d) Some of them have (iv) support two families at a already time (e) Many of them (v) give up their pastoral actually don't want to lives (vi) very often creates problems for them (vii) left their rural lives
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iv) Some of the Kenyans are to support two families at a time. (b) + (vi) Leading two families very often creates problems for them. (c) + (ii) Many of them have come to city for leading a modern life. (d) + (vii) Some of them have already left their rural lives. (e) + (iv) Many of them actually don't want to maintain two families at a time.
